events.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis â€” Ongoing Energy Shock
events.summary: Iran-US-Israel war ongoing since Feb 28, 2026. Strait of Hormuz largely blocked. 25% of world's seaborne oil trade disrupted. Brent crude at $88-91/bbl. EIA reports 5.5M b/d production shut-ins in July. 20,000 mariners stranded. US naval blockade April-May. Renewed tanker attacks in July. Islamabad Memorandum signed. Kushner traveling in region for diplomacy. UPDATE Aug 17 19:02 UTC: Iran and Oman reached agreement on plan for ships to transit Strait of Hormuz, working to finalize details for joint statement. Trump threatens Oman if deal proceeds. Potential de-escalation signal.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic â€” WHO PHEIC, Fastest-Growing on Record
events.summary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC declared WHO PHEIC on May 16, 2026. As of Aug 16: 4,945 confirmed cases, 2,325 deaths (46.86% fatality rate). Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, second-largest ever. Spread to 6 provinces in DRC + Uganda (declared over July 28). No approved vaccine for Bundibugyo species. Armed conflict (M23) hindering response. True scale likely exceeds confirmed numbers.

events.title: US Treasury ESF Yen Intervention â€” First in 15 Years
events.summary: On July 31, 2026, US Treasury sold euros from Exchange Stabilization Fund to buy yen alongside Japan. First US yen intervention in 15 years. Japan's intervention estimated at $30-36B. Yen initially strengthened but gains unraveling by Aug 10 (back to 159/dollar). BOJ pressured to accelerate rate hikes (Sept/Oct). Takaichi government supportive. Bessent pledged open-ended yen support but ESF arsenal constrained.

events.title: South Korean Won Crisis â€” Sharpest Swings Since 2008
events.summary: Korean won weakened from ~1,300 to 1,550/dollar in just over a month, now near 1,400. Volatility highest since 2009 financial crisis. India lured $40B from diaspora via high-yield dollar deposits to stabilize rupee. Emerging Asia guarding reserves with renewed currency defense strategies. Bloomberg reports currency defense 'makeover' across region.
